title: Excellent tour for a big family of all ages
text: We are a family of several elderly adults, several middle aged adults and two young children (ages 4 and 8). Organizing the tour was easy. The email correspondence was prompt and clear. We prepaid for the tour (which always makes me nervous) but all went perfectly smooth. In the few days leading up to the tour, we received very clear Whats App messages as reminders and an introduction to our guide and driver for the day. On the morning of our tour, our guide messaged us upon arrival to our hotel and even arrived a bit early! Our guide, Aurora, was very friendly and mindful of the attention spa
author: Alicia A

title: What a tour from Letango!
text:
Our whole tour was excellent.  Lupe met us promptly and we observed the old homes around Casa Batllo then up the street to the Masi house.

We then took subway our choice Lupe suggested cab but our group was too large for one cab so we suggested the subway.  It was quick and fun.  Her extensive knowledge of Gaudi and the Sagrad Familia was great just
The right amount.  All
In all an excellent experience.
author: JLougheed

title: Great company with great guides and drivers
text: The guide and driver were both great. They were extremely knowledgeable, were both fluent in English and customized the tour to our inerests and to accommodate our 97 year old mom.
author: C1806EHstevenb

title: The sagrada familia is a must-see in Barcelona, but the additional walking tour with Gloria opened up the city
text: Gloria showed us around some of the most interesting part of Madrid and was amazing in how she was able cater the walking tour aspect to out interests. Mine was the intricate and detailed architecture, clearly with Gaudí, but Gloria was also able to bring us to so many other amazing but less well-known buildings due to her intimate knowledge of the city! Additionally, she was super knowledgeable about the sagrada familia itself, especially pertaining to the symbolism present throughout its facades and making it was to the interior.
